core_obligations: Equate (1) with (5) using the functor description and the locality and affineness lemmas (proof lines 1812-1819).
Run the chain (5) => (2) => (3) => (1), refining the covering to affine schemes in the last step (proof lines 1821-1827).
Handle (4) with the pullback lemma and the fact that compositions of tau-coverings are tau-coverings (proof lines 1829-1833).
difficulty_reason: For an O-module F on (Sch/S)_tau the lemma gives five equivalent characterisations: adequacy, the existence of an affine open covering over which F restricts to the kernel of a map of quasi-coherent associated sheaves, the same for a tau-covering, the condition that the pullback along each member of a tau-covering is adequate, and the same kernel description over every affine scheme over S (statement lines 1786-1808). The proof is carried out in three displayed steps: the definition of adequacy in terms of the associated functor is combined with the locality and affineness lemmas to equate (1) and (5); the chain (5) => (2) => (3) is immediate and (3) => (1) is obtained by refining the covering to affines and using the preliminary remark; and (4) is handled with the pullback lemma in one direction and the composition of tau-coverings in the other (proof lines 1811-1833). The level is H3: five conditions reduced to three groups, each reduction with its named input.
